name: Partnership Dominoes
description: Partnership Dominoes is a four-player line domino game. All 28 tiles are dealt, seven each. Partners sit opposite. The double-six tile leads first; the match ends by playing out or by block. First team to 100 wins.

overview.description: Partnership Dominoes is a four-player line domino game. All 28 tiles are dealt, seven each. Partners sit opposite. The double-six tile leads first; the match ends by playing out or by block. First team to 100 wins.

history.evolution: Variants: Doscientos (200), Quinientos (500), Milo (Africa/Indonesia). FID 200-point target.

setup.players: 4 in fixed partnerships. Partners sit opposite.

rules.objective: Be first team to 100 points (or agreed target). Score by going out or by having fewer pips when blocked.
rules.gameplay: 1. Start: In the first hand the holder of the double-six tile leads. Later hands use rotation or the previous winner leads, depending on variant. 2. Play: Add tiles to the line; touching ends must match. Doubles are placed at right angles. Must play if possible; otherwise pass (knock). 3. End: When a player empties their hand the team wins the deal. If blocked (four passes), the team with fewer pips wins. 4. Score: Winners score the losers' unplayed pip total, or all unplayed pips per variant.
keyRules: Must play if possible; pass when blocked.

strategy.basic: Play to empty hand. Block opponents when possible.
strategy.intermediate: Track played tiles. Coordinate with partner via play.
strategy.advanced: Force blocks; manage pip count in blocked hands.
tips: In blocked games, low pip count matters.
